registered_before: any new cbp fit (frozen in FIT_LOCK and AUDIT_AND_SELECTION_LOCK); executable: cbp/select.py
rows: INNER_SELECTION only (attackers fitted on AUDIT_FIT); never assessment values

ordinary_eligibility.scope: EACH seed (0, 1, 2) and EACH task (income, occupation); no averaging across seeds
rules: true-label log loss <= U log loss + 0.01 nats
accuracy gain over the OSF_DEFENSE_FIT-majority constant >= 0.8 x U's gain
exact decision preservation against the release's own teacher (U-derived codes: U's decisions on every row)
ordinary_eligibility.implementation: qpc.utility.gate_record(code, U anchor of the same seed, preserved)['eligible'] (inclusive comparisons)

headroom.scope: privacy NOMINEE candidates only (LOCAL, SEQ-12, SEQ-21, JOINT at every lambda); never used to drop a comparator
rules: true-label log-loss excess vs U <= 0.006 nats for EACH task and seed
true-label Brier excess vs U <= 0.0035 for EACH task and seed
headroom.computed_from: qpc.utility.gate_record per-task ll_excess / brier_excess (NOT qpc's 0.0075 headroom flag)
headroom.status: an inner selection design choice motivated by the qpc uncertainty (0.004 nats before the unchanged 0.01 assessment limit); not a relaxed assessment threshold, not a confidence guarantee, not a proved optimal cutoff

keys: mean over seeds of INNER pair AUC (lower first)
mean over seeds of summed true-label task log loss (lower first)
mean actual total token states (fewer first; continuous releases count as +infinity for ORDERING only, written null in JSON)
ordering.tie_tolerance: keys 1 and 2: each is the float64 seed mean computed as (x_seed0 + x_seed1 + x_seed2) / 3 summed in seed order, then Python round(x, 12); equal rounded values are tied (values less than 1e-12 apart may still fall either side of a rounding boundary); key 3 exact; key 4 lexicographic
ordering.alias_disclosure: key 4 can decide between configurations whose deployed maps are identical (an unchanged JOINT keeps a same-lambda SEQ/LOCAL witness bitwise, and 'U|JOINT|' sorts first). The ordering is NOT changed; instead P*'s alias set (privacy configurations whose qpc pair_fingerprint equals P*'s on ALL three seeds) and partial per-seed aliases are recorded, the label names cbp.family.simplest_family(alias set) (LOCAL < SEQ-12 = SEQ-21 < JOINT), and the alias set plus the ID tie-break are disclosed; the same alias records are kept for J* and every family winner; aliases with the privacy-untrained DIRECT-TASK / FINE-TASK i8o64 maps (identical deployed maps on all seeds) are flagged identical_to_untrained

T*.candidates: CLOSED list: U|DIRECT-TASK|i8o64, U|FINE-TASK|i8o64, SRC|U (U continuous), U|CLASS|i1o1, REF|F0
T*.note: RAW-J beta 0.3 is privacy-trained historically and is EXCLUDED from T* (correction of the qpc legacy T* list, which included SRC|RAW-J); it remains in C_global

C_rate.candidates: U|DIRECT-TASK|i8o64, U|FINE-TASK|i8o64, and LOCAL / SEQ-12 / SEQ-21 at every lambda of the grid (fixed rate i8o64)

C_global.candidates: every nonjoint release of the declared control bank: all C_rate candidates, U|CLASS|i1o1, SRC|U, SRC|RAW-J_b0.3, REF|E, REF|F, REF|F0 (JOINT excluded)

P*.candidates: LOCAL, SEQ-12, SEQ-21, JOINT at every lambda
P*.guard: individual inner AUC (recipient 1 and 2) <= T* + 0.005 for EACH recipient and seed
P*.winning_family: the family of P* is reported (any family may win)
P*.guard_comparison: decided by the registered inclusive comparison a <= g + 0.005 (not by the normalised shortfall); guard_shortfall is exactly 0.0 iff the guard holds and is used for ranking only

J*.guard: individual inner AUC <= C_rate + 0.005 AND <= C_global + 0.005 for EACH recipient and seed

Q.consequence: if U|DIRECT-TASK|i8o64 is not ordinarily eligible on some seed or task, Q is NOT_ESTABLISHED_NO_ELIGIBLE_NOMINEE (ORDINARY_UTILITY_FAILURE) and P34-P37 are scored DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY; a technical failure of it makes Q INCOMPLETE_OR_INVALID

global_configuration: one family/lambda configuration fixed across all three seeds; no per-seed lambda; no assessment-based choice

nominee_roles: INVALID_NOMINEE (technical failure, invalid/non-estimable candidate, or an otherwise eligible nominee blocked only by a missing guard comparator)

fallback_ordering.rule: among the role's candidates when no candidate is nominable: smallest ordinary shortfall, then smallest headroom shortfall, then smallest local-guard shortfall, then the ordering keys
fallback_ordering.ordinary_shortfall: max(0, max over tasks t and seeds k of: (a_U - 0.01 - a)/0.01, (dLL - 0.01)/0.01, (dB - 0.005)/0.005, (0.8*g_U - g)/max(0.8*g_U, 0.03), (0.03 - g)/0.03), where a = accuracy, g = gain over the fitting-majority constant, dLL / dB = log-loss / Brier excess vs U
fallback_ordering.headroom_shortfall: max(0, max over t, k of (dLL - 0.006)/0.006, (dB - 0.0035)/0.0035)  [0 for roles without headroom]
fallback_ordering.local_guard_shortfall: max(0, max over required guards, seeds and recipients of (local AUC - guard comparator local AUC - 0.005)/0.005)
fallback_ordering.invalid: exact decision failure or a non-estimable metric is a separate INVALID status (never a large finite shortfall); if a required guard comparator is missing, no guard-based rank is computed and the dependency is reported invalid; all three shortfalls are recorded separately

prespecified_diagnostics: ordinary_privacy_winner_no_headroom: the strongest ORDINARILY eligible privacy configuration with the T* guard (same candidates and guard as P*, headroom dropped)
strongest_ordinary_privacy_unguarded: the strongest ordinarily eligible privacy configuration with no guard (the prompt line names no guard; both readings reported)

family_headroom_winners: the headroom-selected winner in EACH family (LOCAL, SEQ-12, SEQ-21, JOINT) with the T* guard, or its fixed fallback; the JOINT-family T*-guarded winner is NOT J* (J* is guarded by C_rate and C_global) and both are recorded
source_lambda_0.1_controls: U|JOINT|i8o64|l0.1, U|SEQ-12|i8o64|l0.1, U|SEQ-21|i8o64|l0.1 (ordinary, headroom, mean AUCs, shortfalls)

headroom_changes_winner: changed = (P* config != ordinary winner config); give_up = mean inner pair AUC(P*) - mean inner pair AUC(ordinary winner) (>= 0 by nesting: same candidates and guard), plus the per-seed differences; when either is absent a status is written instead of a number; a fallback is used only with a DESCRIPTIVE flag
assessment_note: the full lambda curve is an INNER figure only; the assessment scores only the locked list (PROTOCOL.md section 12)

invalid_candidates.decision_preservation: a decision-preservation failure of any U-derived candidate (on any seed) is a TECHNICAL failure: the candidate's role is INVALID (INVALID_NOMINEE / INVALID_COMPARATOR, reason FIT_OR_ADMISSION_FAILURE), the candidate is never ranked in a fallback, and the cause is recorded (qpc gate_record's eligible=False alone is not used for this case)
invalid_candidates.non_estimable: a missing, unreadable or nonfinite inner field (pair/v1/v2 AUC, accuracy, log loss, Brier, constant accuracy, excesses) is a technical failure of the same kind
invalid_candidates.references: C_global's references follow the admission record (SOURCE_ADMISSION.json): an inadmissible reference would be excluded and disclosed (none is: all REF|E, REF|F, REF|F0 and both sources were admitted with parity); an admitted candidate that later fails technically makes the role INVALID_COMPARATOR
invalid_candidates.reason_codes: FIT_OR_ADMISSION_FAILURE (missing / incomplete unit), DECISION_PRESERVATION_FAILURE, NON_ESTIMABLE_INNER_METRIC; joined with '+' when several apply

missing_guard: if a required guard comparator has no valid nominee (status other than NOMINEE): when at least one candidate of the role is eligible (ordinary, plus headroom for P*/J*) the role is INVALID_NOMINEE (MISSING_GUARD_COMPARATOR; no guard rank computed, the blocked candidates listed); when none is eligible the guard is not needed for the status and the role is NO_ELIGIBLE_NOMINEE with its ordinary / headroom reason, but the fallback rank uses only the ordinary and headroom shortfalls and the ordering keys and is flagged fallback_rank_status = INVALID_MISSING_GUARD_COMPARATOR (never a zero guard field); the flag is carried onto the scored fallback rows
